lines.text: What would you do if your *homeboy* woke up as a *girl*?!
On the morning of the bio *test*!
Imagine. *7 AM*. A call from your *best friend*.
You answer, and a girl is *screaming* your name.
Memory search: absolutely *no idea* who this is.
Then she says your nickname. It's *him*!
Same cap. Same hoodie. Same chain. Somehow *transformed* overnight.
At first, you think it's a *prank*. But it's *real*.
And the bio test is in one *hour*!
Your homeboy has one *mission*: turn back.
He still acts exactly the *same*. Same couch. Same snacks. Same *scrolling*.
Except now, the scroll is his bio chapter, on *Unspool*.
The test comes back, and he *aces* it.
Would you treat your homeboy *exactly* the same?
What would *you* do? Try Unspool *free* at unspool dot cc.
